reply_text:
I saved the draft mail to Hollis and told Anselm in his direct message.

- **Draft:** it's addressed to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) with the subject "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives $2,101 a seat as Marcus provided it, says Anselm approved sharing it, and asks Hollis to check with Anselm or June Osei-Lark before passing the rate on. It's only a draft, so nothing has been sent.
- **Approval:** Anselm is the CFO, so his own approval was enough to share the rate with Hollis. I didn't need to request approval from anyone else, and the mail stays inside pemberline.com, so Ruth Calloway doesn't need to approve it either.
- **Caveat:** the $2,101 figure comes from Anselm's message alone. I found nothing about Thornbury Cloth Co. in GBrain or the other records I can see, so I couldn't check it against what Marcus originally gave. I suggested to Anselm that he check the number before the mail goes out.
